b3ddb0fabf.q: How much revenue does My Beach Vacation Rentals generate from short-term versus long-term rentals per unit?
b3ddb0fabf.a: On a per unit basis, vacation rentals are far more lucrative than long-term rentals. However, there is significantly more day-to-day work involved with short-term rentals, including weekly or three to four-day turnovers that require constant coordination with cleaners and maintenance staff.
b3ddb0fabf.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal

9242e1c686.q: What percentage of My Beach Vacation Rentals' bookings come through Airbnb versus other platforms?
9242e1c686.a: Airbnb accounts for roughly 60% of their bookings. While legacy companies get significant direct booking, nowadays Airbnb and VRBO are such popular platforms that you have to be on them to maximize revenue. However, Declan notes they are somewhat too dependent on Airbnb currently and are working to get repeat guests to book directly.
9242e1c686.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal

ced76d7314.q: Why did Zillow and Airbnb remove direct contact information from their platforms for property managers?
ced76d7314.a: Both platforms removed phone numbers and direct contact methods because they want to own the tenant or guest data and control that lead. By forcing all inquiries through their messaging systems, they ensure they retain the ability to collect service fees and prevent property managers from booking guests directly outside their platforms.
ced76d7314.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal

98fb4c010a.q: What are the main technology platforms My Beach Vacation Rentals uses for long-term property management?
98fb4c010a.a: Their main PMS is RentVine. For leasing, they recently switched to RentEngine after trying TenantTurner and Haven; they chose RentEngine for its AI capabilities and superior reporting. They also use RentCheck for quarterly inspections.
98fb4c010a.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal

7b8be7b180.q: How many units per month is My Beach Vacation Rentals adding to their long-term portfolio in Myrtle Beach?
7b8be7b180.a: They are growing by approximately five doors a month on average for their long-term side. This growth is driven largely by accidental landlords—people who bought properties with no intention to rent them out but cannot sell due to stagnant real estate sales caused by new construction in the area.
7b8be7b180.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal

0d553a31e1.q: What upfront investment is required to position a million-dollar home as a short-term rental in Myrtle Beach?
0d553a31e1.a: For a home valued around $1.5 million, owners would need to invest approximately $150,000 to $200,000 in design work and amenities like a pool to make it competitive as a short-term rental. Many owners decide this investment is not worth it and opt for long-term rentals instead.
0d553a31e1.e: Long-Term & Short-Term Property Management: Two Completely Different Businesses | Declan McGonigal
